owner_request: Add about 25–30 questions for the gaps found in the 23 October bank review and correct the statements it flagged; then add about five more questions whose answer is None of the above.
method_summary: 27 questions added and 12 revised. Every added or revised item was answered blind, statement by statement in both languages, from the cited sources by Claude subagents (claude-opus-5-5, the same model as the author) working in fresh contexts without keys, explanations or quotes; this is independent-context review, not a different-model panel. No verdict differed from the key in any round. After round 1 (34 items) the wording reviewers questioned and the differences between languages were corrected, and 22 items were reviewed again by two new subagents, with doubts limited to cases where a careful candidate could reasonably reach the opposite verdict; round 3 reviewed the five items with no true statement added on the owner's second request. One round-2 doubt (m6-480, how the Chinese writes the more-than-25% threshold) is kept with the author's resolution. Each recorded verdict is bound to the final stem, statements and citation by a text hash.

quotes.tc: 金錢服務經營者須按照客戶、司法管轄區、產品／服務及交付渠道的風險，來識別、評估和理解其業務的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險。

quotes.en: when establishing or maintaining business relationships with potential or existing customers, business partners, and/or counterparties who are part of the MSOs’ delivery channels for effecting the remittance, MSOs should exercise caution
quotes.tc: 金錢服務經營者與潛在或現有客戶、業務夥伴及／或交易對手(作為金錢服務經營者交付渠道的一部分，以發出匯款指示)建立或維持業務關係時，尤其應審慎評估此等渠道面對的洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險程度。

quotes.en: they should, as soon as reasonably practical, file a suspicious transaction report with the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit (JFIU).
quotes.tc: 金錢服務經營者須在切實可行範圍內，盡快向聯合財富情報組提交可疑交易報告。

quotes.en: in which customers’ funds were frozen by the regulatory bodies or law enforcement agencies in other jurisdictions
quotes.tc: 近期發生金錢服務經營者因客戶資金遭其他司法管轄區的監管或執法機構凍結，而未能進行跨境匯款的事件。

notes: False (timing): ¶6 expects a comprehensive risk assessment before engaging other parties in the business model; the regular review of channels in ¶3 is additional, not a substitute for assessing first.

False: ¶2 bases the IRA on customer, jurisdiction, product/service and delivery channel risks, and ¶1 stresses the IRA particularly on delivery channel risks outside Hong Kong. Minor wording only: EN statement says 'product', TC 產品／服務; immaterial to the verdict.
False (scope): ¶3 covers potential or existing customers, business partners and/or counterparties who are part of the MSO's delivery channels.
False (actor): ¶5 requires a suspicious transaction report to the JFIU as soon as reasonably practical; nothing about reporting to an overseas authority.
False: ¶1 refers to customers' funds frozen by regulatory bodies or law enforcement agencies in other jurisdictions, not in Hong Kong.

quotes.en: Whilst an applicant falling within section 30(4) will be subject to scrutiny as to his fitness and propriety to operate a money service, the CCE will have regard to the facts and circumstances of each individual applicant before determining whether he/she is a fit and proper person.
quotes.tc: 雖然倘申請人屬第30(4)條所指定的人士，其是否適合經營金錢服務便須經過仔細審查，但關長亦會考慮個別申請人的事實及情況，才斷定申請人是否適當人選。

quotes.en: Whether the person has failed to comply with any requirement imposed under the AMLO or any regulation made by the CCE.
quotes.tc: 該人是否曾不遵從打擊洗錢條例施加的要求或關長訂立的任何規例。

quotes.en: Whether the person, being a corporation, is in the course of being wound-up or where a receiver, or such other person having the powers and duties of a receiver, has been appointed in relation to or in respect of any property of the corporation.
quotes.tc: (如該人屬法團)該人是否在清盤中，或是否有接管人或具接管人權力及責任的其他人士已就該法團或法團任何財產而獲委任。

quotes.en: The Guideline provides general guidance and are not intended to be exhaustive or comprehensive.
quotes.tc: 本文件乃一般性指引，並未全面或毫無遺漏地列出所有相關事項。

notes: False: ¶3 says an applicant within s.30(4) is subject to scrutiny, and the CCE has regard to the facts and circumstances of each applicant before deciding; no automatic refusal (B3).
False (scope): ¶5(a) covers failure to comply with any requirement imposed under the AMLO or any regulation made by the CCE.

False: ¶5(c) is engaged where a corporation is in the course of being wound up or a receiver (or person with a receiver's powers and duties) has been appointed over its property; dissolution is not the trigger.

False: ¶6 says the Guideline is not intended to be exhaustive or comprehensive and all relevant factors are considered, including but not limited to the AMLO criteria and ¶5; ¶2 also lets the CCE take into account any other matter he considers relevant.

quotes.en: an MSO should monitor and maintain records of who have been trained, when the staff received the training and the type of the training provided.
quotes.tc: 金錢服務經營者應監察誰人已接受培訓、職員何時接受培訓，以及所提供培訓的類別，並備存紀錄。

quotes.en: all new staff, irrespective of seniority
quotes.tc: 所有新職員（不論資歷）

quotes.en: Apart from the initial training, an MSO should also provide refresher training regularly to ensure that its staff are reminded of their responsibilities and are kept informed of new developments related to ML/TF.
quotes.tc: 金錢服務經營者除要安排初步培訓外，亦應定期舉辦複修培訓，確保其職員明白本身的責任，並掌握有關洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的最新發展。

quotes.en: The MSO should be able to demonstrate to the CCE that all materials are up-to-date and in line with current requirements and standards.
quotes.tc: 金錢服務經營者應能夠向關長證明所有培訓材料應是最新的，並且應符合現行規定及標準。

notes: False: ¶9.7 requires records of who has been trained, when, and the type of training provided (kept for at least 3 years).

False (scope): ¶9.2 makes adequate training of its staff the MSO's responsibility, and ¶9.5 sets training for all new staff irrespective of seniority, back-office staff, managerial staff and MLROs, as well as front-line staff (whose role as first point of contact is ¶9.5(b)(i)).
False: ¶9.2 requires refresher training regularly, apart from initial training, to keep staff informed of new ML/TF developments; event-driven sessions cannot replace regular refresher training.
False (actor): ¶9.6 says the MSO should be able to demonstrate to the CCE that all materials are up to date and in line with current requirements and standards.

quotes.en: While MSOs do not normally have any obligation under Hong Kong laws to have regard to unilateral sanctions imposed by other organisations or authorities in other jurisdictions, an MSO operating internationally will need to be aware of the scope and focus of relevant sanctions regimes in those jurisdictions.
quotes.tc: 雖然根據香港法律，金錢服務經營者一般並無任何責任關注其他司法管轄區的其他組織或主管當局實施的單方面制裁措施，但經營國際業務的金錢服務經營者仍須注意該等司法管轄區的相關制裁制度的範疇及重點

quotes.en: Where these sanctions regimes may affect its operations, the MSO should consider what implications exist and take appropriate measures.
quotes.tc: 如這些制裁制度可能對金錢服務經營者的業務構成影響，則金錢服務經營者應考慮這會引致甚麼影響，並採取適當措施。

quotes.en: persons or entities acting on the behalf of or at the direction of the designated persons or entities, or owned or controlled by them
quotes.tc: 向代表被指認的個人或實體、按其指示行事，或由其擁有或控制的一干個人或實體

quotes.en: persons or entities acting on the behalf of or at the direction of the designated persons or entities, or owned or controlled by them, or (iii) entities owned by the aforementioned
quotes.tc: (ii) 向代表被指認的個人或實體、按其指示行事，或由其擁有或控制的一干個人或實體、或 (iii) 向上文所述者擁有的實體 直接或間接提供任何資金

notes: True: ¶6.11 – no normal Hong Kong-law obligation to regard unilateral foreign sanctions, but an MSO operating internationally will need to be aware of their scope and focus.
True: ¶6.11 – where these regimes may affect its operations, the MSO should consider the implications and take appropriate measures.
False (reversed/scope): ¶6.7(a)(ii) covers persons or entities 'owned or controlled by' designated persons or entities, so controlled entities are included.
True: ¶6.7(a)(iii) 'entities owned by the aforementioned' – the aforementioned include (ii) persons acting on behalf of a designated person or entity.

quotes.en: Effective ML/TF risk management requires adequate governance arrangements.
quotes.tc: 要有效管理洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，必須作出適當的管治安排。

quotes.en: The board of directors or its delegated committee (where applicable), and senior management of an MSO should have a clear understanding of its ML/TF risks
quotes.tc: 金錢服務經營者的董事會或獲其授權的委員會（如適用）及高級管理層應清楚了解金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

quotes.en: senior management of an MSO should have a clear understanding of its ML/TF risks and ensure that the risks are adequately managed.
quotes.tc: 高級管理層應清楚了解金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並確保已妥善管理有關風險。

quotes.en: Management information regarding ML/TF risks and the AML/CFT Systems should be communicated to them in a timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner
quotes.tc: 關於洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險及打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的管理資料，應以合時、完整、易於理解及準確方式通知高級管理層

notes: True: ¶3.6 opens with this sentence; 'within the MSO' / 在其機構內 only places the arrangements and changes nothing.
True: ¶3.6, the board or its delegated committee (where applicable) and senior management should have a clear understanding of the MSO's ML/TF risks.

True: ¶3.6, the same bodies should 'ensure that the risks are adequately managed'. Leaving out '(where applicable)' here does not change the duty, because the statement still names the board or its committee.

True in both views: the English ¶3.6 sends management information to 'them' (the board or committee and senior management), so senior management is one recipient and the statement does not claim it is the only one; the Chinese ¶3.6 says 通知高級管理層 (conflict call E29). The timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner matches both texts.

quotes.en: If a financial institution acts as an intermediary institution in a wire transfer, it must transmit all of the information that it receives with the transfer to the institution to which it passes on the transfer instruction.
quotes.tc: 如金融機構在電傳轉賬中以中介機構身分行事，它須將其連同該項轉賬一併獲得的所有資料，傳遞予收取它的轉賬指示的機構。

quotes.en: Where a financial institution is a beneficiary institution in a domestic wire transfer— (a) if the wire transfer is not accompanied by the information required under subsection (3)(b), it must as soon as reasonably practicable— (i) obtain the information from the institution from which it receives the transfer instruction
quotes.tc: 如金融機構在本地電傳轉賬中屬收款機構，則 —— (a) 如有關電傳轉賬並無附隨根據第(3)(b) 款規定的資料，該金融機構須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快 —— (i) 向發出轉賬指示予它的機構，取得有關資料

quotes.en: if the financial institution is aware that the accompanying information that purports to be the information required under subsection (3)(b) is incomplete or meaningless, it must as soon as reasonably practicable take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing involved.
quotes.tc: 如該金融機構察覺到附隨的看來是第(3)(b) 款所規定的資料並不完整，或不具意義，它須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快採取合理措施，減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的風險。

quotes.en: is a beneficiary institution or an intermediary institution in a wire transfer that is not a domestic wire transfer— (Amended 4 of 2018 s. 26) (a) if the wire transfer is not accompanied by all of the information required under subsection (3), it must as soon as reasonably practicable— (i) obtain the missing information
quotes.tc: 如金融機構在並非本地電傳轉賬的電傳轉賬中屬收款機構或中介機構，則 —— ( 由2018 年第4 號第26 條修訂) (a) 如該項轉賬並無附隨根據第(3) 款規定的資料，該金融機構須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快 —— (i) 向發出轉賬指示予它的機構，取得有關的遺漏資料

quotes.en: if the missing information cannot be obtained, either— (A) consider restricting or terminating its business relationship with the institution referred to in subparagraph (i); or (B) take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing involved
quotes.tc: ( 如未能取得有關的遺漏資料) —— (A) 考慮限制或結束它與第(i) 節提述的機構的業務關係；或 (B) 採取合理措施，減低所涉的洗錢或恐怖分子資金籌集的風險

notes: True: s.12(8) verbatim.

True: s.12(9)(a)(i) – domestic transfer without the s.12(3)(b) account/unique reference number: obtain it from the instructing institution as soon as reasonably practicable (consistent with CONFLICT-CALLS B20, law side).

True: s.12(9)(b) for domestic and s.12(10)(b) for non-domestic transfers both require a beneficiary institution aware of incomplete or meaningless purported information to take reasonable mitigating measures as soon as reasonably practicable.
True: s.12(10)(a) applies to a beneficiary institution 'or an intermediary institution' in a non-domestic wire transfer.
True: s.12(9)(a)(ii)/(10)(a)(ii) – either (A) consider restricting or terminating the relationship with the instructing institution, or (B) take reasonable mitigating measures.

quotes.en: If the intermediary institution is aware that the accompanying information that purports to be the required originator information or required recipient information is incomplete or meaningless, it must as soon as reasonably practicable take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of ML/TF involved.
quotes.tc: 如中介機構察覺到附隨於電傳轉帳看來是所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料並不完整，或不具意義，它須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快採取合理措施，減低所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的風險。

quotes.en: if a domestic or cross-border wire transfer is not accompanied by the required originator information or required recipient information, the beneficiary institution must as soon as reasonably practicable, obtain the missing information from the institution from which it receives the transfer instruction.
quotes.tc: 如本地或跨境電傳轉帳並無附隨所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料，收款機構須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快向發出轉帳指示予它的機構

quotes.en: In the case of an MSO that controls both the ordering and the beneficiary sides of a wire transfer, the MSO should also file an STR in any jurisdiction affected by the suspicious wire transfer
quotes.tc: 如金錢服務經營者控制電傳轉帳的匯款方和收款方，便應在受可疑電傳轉帳影響的司法管轄區提交可疑交易報告

quotes.en: and make relevant transaction information available to the Financial Intelligence Unit.
quotes.tc: 提交可疑交易報告，並向財富情報組提供相關交易資料。

notes: True: ¶10.18 in substance: an intermediary institution aware that the information is incomplete or meaningless must, as soon as reasonably practicable, take reasonable measures to mitigate the ML/TF risk.

False: ¶10.20 makes the beneficiary institution obtain any missing required originator or recipient information, for a domestic or a cross-border transfer. The rule that only the missing account or reference number is sought comes from AMLO Sch. 2 s.12(9)(a), not from the Guideline (conflict call B20).

True: ¶7.19, 2nd paragraph: an MSO controlling both sides should also file an STR in any jurisdiction affected, which means every affected jurisdiction (conflict call E30). The Chinese text 在受可疑電傳轉帳影響的司法管轄區 supports 每個.
False: the transaction information goes to 'the Financial Intelligence Unit' (Chinese: 財富情報組), not the Commissioner of Customs and Excise.

quotes.en: but does not include such a service that is incidental to the main business e.g. retail business accepting foreign currencies in transactions
quotes.tc: 但不包括附帶於主要業務的該等服務，例如在交易中接受外幣的零售業務

quotes.en: (b) consists solely of transactions for the purchase by that person of non‐Hong Kong currencies in exchange for Hong Kong currency
quotes.tc: (b) 只包括該人以港元貨幣作兌換的購入非港元貨幣的交易

quotes.en: (c) arranging for the receipt of money in a place outside Hong Kong
quotes.tc: (c) 安排在香港以外地方收取金錢

quotes.en: CCE will not accept any application for grant or renewal of licence if an applicant has been exempted from the MSO licensing requirements.
quotes.tc: 如申請人本身獲豁免於金錢服務經營者的發牌規定，關長將不會接納任何由其提出要求批給牌照或將牌照續期的申請。

notes: True: ¶2.3 excludes a service incidental to the main business, e.g. retail business accepting foreign currencies in transactions; the statement attributes this to the Licensing Guide (CONFLICT-CALLS B26).

False (condition): the hotel exclusion in ¶2.3 also requires the service to consist solely of the hotel's purchases of non-HK currencies for HK currency (and to be on hotel premises primarily for guests); selling foreign notes does not qualify merely because customers are guests.
True: ¶2.4(c) – arranging for the receipt of money in a place outside Hong Kong, operated in Hong Kong as a business, is a remittance service.
True: ¶3.1 – CCE will not accept any application from an exempted applicant (CONFLICT-CALLS W5).

quotes.en: to impose a licence condition under section 30
quotes.tc: 根據第30 條施加牌照條件

quotes.en: to refuse to give approval to a person becoming a partner in a partnership that is a licensee under section 37
quotes.tc: 拒絕根據第37 條給予批准讓某人成為屬持牌人的合夥的合夥人

quotes.en: to refuse to grant an application to operate a money service at particular premises under section 39
quotes.tc: 拒絕根據第39 條批准要求在特定處所經營金錢服務的申請

quotes.locator: s.29(3) (a court order, not a decision of the Commissioner listed in s.54 'specified decision' (d))
quotes.en: If a person is convicted of an offence under this section, the court or magistrate may order that the person is to be disqualified from holding a licence
quotes.tc: 如任何人被裁定犯本條所訂罪行，法庭或裁判官可命令取消該人在該命令指明的始於該命令的日期的期間持有牌照的資格

quotes.locator: s.41(2) (cancellation on return is not among the decisions listed in s.54 'specified decision' (d))
quotes.en: The Commissioner must, as soon as reasonably practicable after receiving a licence under subsection (1)(b)— (a) cancel or amend the licence
quotes.tc: 關長在收到第(1)(b) 款所指的牌照後，須在合理地切實可行範圍內，盡快 —— (a) 取消或修訂該牌照

quotes.en: to exercise any of the powers under section 43
quotes.tc: 行使第43 條所指的任何權力

quotes.en: “Credible sources” refers to information that is produced by reputable and universally recognised international organisations and other bodies that make such information publicly and widely available.
quotes.tc: 「可靠消息來源」是指由一些有良好聲譽和廣為人知的國際組織及其他組織所提供及廣泛流傳的資訊。

quotes.en: such sources may include, but are not limited to, supra-national or international bodies such as the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank and the Egmont Group of Financial Intelligence Units, as well as relevant national government bodies and non-government organisations.
quotes.tc: 這些來源可包括（但不限於）超國家或國際組織，例如國際貨幣基金組織、世界銀行及埃格蒙特金融情報組織，以及有關的政府組織和非政府機構。

quotes.en: International organisations referred to in paragraph [4.9.14] are entities established by formal political agreements between their member States that have the status of international treaties
quotes.tc: 第[4.9.14]段所指的國際組織指由成員國根據具有國際條約地位的正式政治協議成立的實體

quotes.en: The statement sets out the list of jurisdictions that have committed to resolve swiftly strategic deficiencies in their regime to counter money laundering, terrorist financing, and proliferation financing within agreed timeframes and are subject to increased monitoring.
quotes.tc: 該聲明載有承諾於協定時間內迅速解決其在打擊洗錢、恐怖分子資金籌集及大規模毀滅武器擴散資金籌集制度方面的策略性缺失，且受加強監察的司法管轄區的名單。

quotes.en: conducting EDD is not mandatory for customers connected to jurisdictions listed in the FATF statement: “Improving Global Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism (“AML/CFT”) Compliance: On-going Process”.
quotes.tc: 對與題為“改善全球打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集的合規情況：持續進展”的特別組織聲明所列司法管轄區有關連的客戶採取更嚴格盡職審查措施並非強制性規定

notes: True: footnote 3 to ¶2.4 defines credible sources in these words (Chinese: 由一些有良好聲譽和廣為人知的國際組織及其他組織所提供及廣泛流傳的資訊).
False: footnote 3 includes 'relevant national government bodies and non-government organisations' (有關的政府組織和非政府機構); non-government organisations are not excluded.

True: ¶4.9.15, the international organisations of the international-organisation-PEP definition are entities established by formal political agreements between member States that have the status of international treaties. This is one of three criteria, and the statement does not claim it is the only one.

True: circular MSSB/FATF_02/2026 item (2) (and Note 6): the jurisdictions have committed to resolve strategic ML/TF/PF deficiencies swiftly within agreed timeframes and are subject to increased monitoring.

True: FAQ A17: EDD is not mandatory for customers connected to jurisdictions on the 'On-going Process' statement, though the connection is weighed in the risk profile (conflict call B18: today's Increased Monitoring list).

quotes.en: omits a material particular from a statement with the result that the statement is rendered false or misleading
quotes.tc: 在某項陳述中遺漏任何要項，以致該項陳述成為虛假或具誤導性的陳述

quotes.en: rendered false or misleading; and (b) knows that, or is reckless as to whether, the material particular is omitted from the statement
quotes.tc: 以致該項陳述成為虛假或具誤導性的陳述；及 (b) 知道該項陳述遺漏該要項，或罔顧該項陳述是否遺漏該要項

quotes.en: with the result that the statement is rendered false or misleading; and (b) knows that, or is reckless as to whether, the material particular is omitted from the statement
quotes.tc: 遺漏任何要項，以致該項陳述成為虛假或具誤導性的陳述；及 (b) 知道該項陳述遺漏該要項，或罔顧該項陳述是否遺漏該要項，即屬犯罪

quotes.en: knows that, or is reckless as to whether, the material particular is omitted from the statement
quotes.tc: 知道該項陳述遺漏該要項，或罔顧該項陳述是否遺漏該要項

quotes.en: Legal person refers to any entities other than natural person that can establish a permanent customer relationship with an MSO or otherwise own property.

doubts: Chinese view only: the Chinese threshold is 「25%以上」, and in common Chinese legal usage 以上 can include the figure itself, so a candidate reading only the Chinese could reasonably take exactly 25% as meeting it. The English 'more than 25%', 「（即25%以上）」 for '(i.e. more than 25%)' in ¶4.4.9, and the drafting pattern of 「或以上」 where the figure is included (e.g. $8,000或以上) all point to false.
notes: False: ¶4.4.6(a)(i) requires more than 25% of the issued share capital, and exactly 25% does not exceed 25%.
True: ¶4.4.6(a)(iii): an individual who exercises ultimate control over the management of the corporation is a beneficial owner, whether or not he holds shares.

False: ¶4.4.9 requires the MSO to identify the natural persons who ultimately hold a controlling ownership interest, and ¶4.4.1 and ¶4.4.13 require it to follow the chain to natural persons. The holding company, a corporation, is not where identification stops.

True: ¶4.4.9 uses the senior-managing-official fallback only if no natural person falls within the definitions in ¶4.4.6–4.4.8. Mr Lee falls within ¶4.4.6(a)(iii), so the fallback is not triggered (the look-through of the 75% holding is a separate matter).

resolutions: Kept, false in both languages. The official Chinese texts write "more than 25%" as 25%以上 (Sch. 2 s.1 beneficial owner; Guideline ¶4.4.9 （即25%以上） for "(i.e. more than 25%)") and write an inclusive threshold as 或以上 (Sch. 2 s.13(1) $8,000 或以上 for "equal to or above $8,000"), so exactly 25% does not qualify. The Chinese explanation now teaches this convention, which is the trap the statement tests.
